review:
Mahjong tiles on a 5x5 grid with up to 2,000 ways, and one of Pragmatic's biggest ceilings: up to 100,000x. In the base game, a multiplier rises with each consecutive tumble, up to 5x.

Symbols on reels two to four can turn gold, and a gold tile in a win leaves a wild for the next tumble. Three scatters give 10 free spins with all of reel three gold. One to four Super Scatters in the trigger pay 50x, 500x, 5,000x or 100,000x. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
